name: Chunk Data Modification & Queue Management
definition: Processes chunk modifications, expands voxel arrays if sparse, updates block types, tracks adjacent chunks for mesh regeneration, and queues affected chunks for mesh loading.
summary: Chunk Data Modification and Queue Management updates voxel data and queues affected chunks for mesh regeneration, differing from sparse octrees by using fixed-size dense grids and from compact storage by explicitly managing mesh updates.
